Definition: of uncertain origin; Thaddæus, one of the Apostles:--Thaddæus.
BiblicalUsage: Thaddaeus is one of the twelve apostles, also called Lebbaeus and Judas the son of James. In Matthew 10:3, whose surname was Thaddaeus. The fuller story is told on the Thaddaeus profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Thaddaeus shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families.
